verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.sardine.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index that links to Markdown (.md) versions of doc pages, which is exactly what an agent can be pointed at. The guides themselves are also served as .md URLs. However, the step-by-step integration guides, API references, SDKs and sample apps sit behind protected access, which limits what an agent can reach without credentials. Missing for 10: agent access to the gated API references and SDK docs, evidence of an llms-full.txt or other agent-specific guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usage.
